events.title: Thesis: DC-HKNN
events.short: A new nearest-neighbour method for finding which floor, and where, a phone is.
events.long: GPS doesn't work well indoors. Wi-Fi fingerprinting fills the gap: record signal strength from every access point at known spots, then match a phone's live reading against that map. Standard KNN averages the closest matches even when they sit on different floors or far apart. DC-HKNN settles the floor first, then keeps only neighbours that pass two checks, one in signal space and one in physical space.
events.note: Collected in a multi-floor building at KMITL with 18 Wi-Fi access points. Both baselines run on the same test split; hierarchical KNN reaches 3.656 m.
events.demoNote: An illustration of the idea on a toy map, not the trained model.

cv.title: DC-HKNN: dual-constrained hierarchical KNN
cv.detail: Floor-first Wi-Fi fingerprinting. 2.225 m mean error and 100% floor accuracy, vs 3.814 m for standard KNN on the same data (18 access points, multi-floor building).

builds.title: Finly
builds.kicker: Longest-running project · spreadsheet since 2022, app since 2026
builds.desc: My money in one place. It started as an Excel sheet and is now a web app on its eighth major version: spending and budgets, credit-card billing cycles, savings goals, and live brokerage and crypto positions with returns compared against the S&P 500. Monthly reports and card reminders arrive in Discord, and the app is locked with 2FA, a PIN and biometrics.
